mapper.select: SELECT resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, level FROM sys_resource_acl WHERE resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_resource_acl WHERE resource_type = #{resourceType} AND resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_resource_acl (resource_type, resource_id, subject_type, subject_id, level, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{level}, now(), now(), 'system', 'system') ON CONFLICT (resource_type, resource_id, subject_type, subject_id) DO UPDATE SET level = EXCLUDED.level, update_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT resource_type AS resourceType, resource_id AS resourceId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_id AS subjectId, level FROM sys_resource_acl WHERE resource_type = #{resourceType} AND ( (subject_type = 'user' AND subject_id = #{userId}) OR (subject_type = 'workspace' AND subject_id = #{workspaceId}) OR (subject_type = 'group' AND subject_id = ANY(#{groupIds}::varchar[])) )
